_comment: Copy to .env.<instance>.json (e.g. .env.staging.json) and fill in. Project name must be lowercase letters/digits/-/_ and start with a letter/digit. The first provider in `providers` becomes pick_first_provider default. Chat sandbox shares the same account pool — no separate chat users.

compose.CF_API_TOKEN: CHANGE_ME (Cloudflare token: Zone:DNS:Edit + Zone:Zone:Read, scoped to your zone; used by Caddy for DNS-01)
compose.FRP_SERVER_ADDR: your.relay.ip (the frp relay public IP, e.g. a Seoul VPS)
compose.FRP_TOKEN: CHANGE_ME (openssl rand -hex 32; must match the relay's frps)
